newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATEKO BANK 1996 NET PROFIT RISES.
newsitem.headline: LATEKO BANK 1996 NET PROFIT RISES.

text.p: Lateko Bank, the 16th largest bank, said on Thursday that its 1996 profit after tax was 704,000 lats versus 388,000 lats in 1995.
The bank also said in a statement that its assets rose in 1996 to 17.86 million lats from 9.97 million lats.
Net interest income was 726,000 lats versus 294,000 lats, foreign exchange profit was 825,000 lats versus 259,000 lats and the net gain from trading operations was 230,000 lats versus 16,000 lats.
The total income for 1996 was 2.17 million lats versus 896,000 lats.
The bank also made provision for losses of 547,000 lats after a recovery for losses of 113,000 lats in 1995.
Pre-tax profit was 715,000 lats versus 399,000 lats.
